items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical file upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could result in arbitrary code execution and privilege escalation.

items.title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-49
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, and denial-of-service, affecting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update resolves multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and gain unauthorized access to store data.
